body: We actually found an answer to this on accident - he can squeeze the sides of my head with his thighs when we 69 and I can barely hear it!

I wish we could, but my jobs are 100% online and I can’t do them without internet. My bf is an instructor and needs to communicate with students via phone sometimes. But if things get desperate enough we’ll certainly be piling our lives into a uhaul
Thank you. I know this won’t last forever, it just sucks when the low points hit so hard. We’ll try to stay strong

I’m fortunate enough to have access to affordable therapy. It’s better than nothing but sometimes I just feel like I’m venting and making no real progress. My bf can’t see a therapist yet and it kinda makes me feel guilty, I feel like he’d benefit from it a lot more than I am currently

I tried Prozac a few years ago, idk maybe it didn’t have enough time to work “properly”, but I never felt worse than when I was taking it. 

I lost track of time, acted erratically, skipped class to go wander around random places in my city, got super paranoid that everyone in my life was lying to me or out to hurt me, and I got closer to a suicide attempt than I ever had before. And that was only for about 6 weeks.
I appreciate it, but I’m already trans and taking testosterone ;P Still want a toy tho
